quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) results: consolidated net sales JPY 118,229 million (+8.4% YoY), operating profit JPY 20,819 million (+26.6%), ordinary profit JPY 21,544 million (+22.6%) and profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 41,770 million (+225.4%); management states sales of high value-added products were strong, led by the Electronic Materials business. Net profit includes extraordinary income of JPY 38,149 million, mainly a JPY 34,165 million gain on sale of fixed assets; ROE was 27.5%.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 118,229 million (+8.4%); operating profit JPY 20,819 million (+26.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic Materials segment, FY2026: net sales JPY 49,265 million (+20.4% YoY) and operating profit JPY 19,391 million (+39.7%); segment assets JPY 129,381 million (+JPY 26,468 million). Management states strong demand for AI servers continued, and sales of low-dielectric special glass and of low-thermal-expansion special glass for semiconductor package substrates were strong. The company holds both glass fiber yarn production and glass cloth processing; it states it has high competitiveness from its proprietary special-composition glass, but expects technical catch-up by companies in Japan and overseas and will further strengthen R&D and its capacity to make high value-added products.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic Materials net sales JPY 49,265 million (+20.4%); operating profit JPY 19,391 million (+39.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, FY2026: Medical net sales JPY 13,850 million (+1.8%), operating profit JPY 2,431 million (+2.1%), with sales of in-vitro diagnostics steady despite China's growing preference for domestic products; Composites net sales JPY 13,401 million (-0.5%), operating loss JPY 122 million (operating loss JPY 900 million a year earlier); Materials and Chemicals net sales JPY 9,515 million (+0.9%), operating profit JPY 588 million (-29.9%) on raw-material cost increases despite price increases; Insulation net sales JPY 15,136 million (-1.2%), operating profit JPY 202 million (-70.8%) on weak housing sales and periodic-repair costs; Other net sales JPY 17,059 million (+4.7%), operating profit JPY 488 million (+19.3%).

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term plan (April 2024 - March 2028) targets raised: in the plan's second year, the surge in AI-server demand lifted sales of special glass, especially low-thermal-expansion glass, and with a weaker yen operating profit reached the original final-year target of JPY 20 billion ahead of schedule. The company is bringing forward capacity-expansion investment in special glass, especially low-thermal-expansion glass, and raised its targets for the plan's final year, FY2028 (April 2027 - March 2028; the company's fiscal 2027): net sales JPY 155 billion (from JPY 135 billion), operating profit JPY 36 billion (from JPY 20 billion), EBITDA JPY 51 billion (from JPY 32 billion); four-year cumulative capex about JPY 120 billion (from about JPY 80 billion) and R&D about JPY 16 billion (from about JPY 15 billion). It notes that geopolitical risk and other external factors still need to be considered.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2028 targets: net sales JPY 155,000 million; operating profit JPY 36,000 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facility: glass cloth production equipment at the Fukushima Business Center (Fukushima City, Fukushima), Electronic Materials segment; total planned investment JPY 15,000 million, of which JPY 2,703 million already paid; started October 2025, completion scheduled for December 2026. The company states that if all the added capacity were used for T-glass cloth for leading-edge logic ICs, output would be about 3 times current production.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 15,000 million; completion December 2026; about 3x T-glass cloth output

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki annual securities report: FY2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, FY2026: group R&D expenses JPY 3,400 million, of which Electronic Materials JPY 1,493 million. For next-generation high-speed communication standards the company is developing NEZ glass cloth, a next-generation glass cloth with lower dielectric constant and dissipation factor than its NE glass and NER glass cloth now on the market, and Vlex glass cloth with lower thermal expansion than its T-glass cloth; it is also developing and improving high-performance ultra-thin glass cloth for SiP and AiP in mobile devices. Patents held (including utility models): 799 (Japan and overseas) as of March 31, 2026; 50 filed in the year.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 3,400 million; Electronic Materials JPY 1,493 million
